Lessons.Title: Guess the Figure (optional)
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will apply your understanding of geometric figures and measurements to draw, describe, and identify two-dimensional figures.
This lesson is optional because it does not address any new mathematical content standards. This lesson does provide you with an opportunity to apply precursor skills of mathematical modeling. In the first activity, you practice using the geometric vocabulary you acquired during the unit to describe changes you notice in a given figure.
2021 lesson activities: Warm-up: Notice and Wonder: Two Figures (10 minutes); Activity 1: Make a Change (15 minutes); Activity 2: Guess My Figure (20 minutes)
Corrected mathematical focus: Describe a 2D figure with mathematically precise attributes so another person can draw and identify it.

Edulytics authored guidance: Check the original source image and figure cards before choosing a construction. Draw the selected figure with at least one controlled change. Describe the changed parallel lines, angles or segment lengths; a partner tests whether the description determines the figure.
First-party Cool-down (not publisher assessment): Draw a rectangle and tell a partner the properties that identify it.
Images, drawing/protractor accuracy, partner tasks and the gated original publisher Cool-down require original task evidence and teacher/visual review.
